normalized.description:
This is a procurement for acquiring an analytical and processing platform dedicated to the exploitation of the NORM data.
The outcome of the project is to develop and deliver a flexible and modular platform capable to ingest and process space radiation data, and in particular that from the NORM instrument that is transferred from Norway to JRC, and to ensure continuous exploitation of this data flow. 
The project will also be useful for DEFIS to promote its action on space weather and space radiation.
